verses.original: שֵׁ֭ם נִבְחָ֣ר רָ֑ב מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃ מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב
verses.transliteration: šēm niḇ·ḥār rāḇ mê·‘ō·šer ḥên ṭō·wḇ mik·ke·sep̄ ū·miz·zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: A good name is more desirable than great riches favor is better than silver and gold

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ יְהוָֽה׃ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr wā·rāš nip̄·gā·šū Yah·weh ‘ō·śêh ḵul·lām
verses.literal: The rich and the poor have this in common The LORD [is] Maker of them all

verses.original: עָר֤וּם׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה וְיִסָּתֵר וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rūm rā·’āh rā·‘āh wə·yis·så̄·ṯēr ū·p̄ə·ṯā·yîm ‘ā·ḇə·rū wə·ne·‘ĕ·nā·šū
verses.literal: The prudent see danger and take cover but the simple keep going and suffer the consequences

verses.original: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·qeḇ ‘ă·nā·wāh yir·’aṯ Yah·weh ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: The rewards of humility [and] the fear of the LORD [are] wealth and honor and life

verses.original: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣin·nîm pa·ḥîm bə·ḏe·reḵ ‘iq·qêš šō·w·mêr nap̄·šōw yir·ḥaq mê·hem
verses.literal: Thorns and snares [lie] on the path of the perverse he who guards his soul stays far from them

verses.original: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־ דַרְכּ֑וֹ פִּ֣י גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־ יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־ יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·nōḵ lan·na·‘ar ‘al- ḏar·kōw pî gam kî- yaz·qîn lō- yā·sūr mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Train up a child in the way he should go and when he is old he will not depart from it

verses.original: עָ֭שִׁיר יִמְשׁ֑וֹל בְּרָשִׁ֣ים לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ וְעֶ֥בֶד מַלְוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr yim·šō·wl bə·rā·šîm lō·weh lə·’îš wə·‘e·ḇeḏ mal·weh
verses.literal: The rich rule over the poor and the borrower . . . is slave to the lender

verses.original: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יִקְצוֹר אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zō·w·rê·a‘ ‘aw·lāh yiq·ṣōr ’ā·wen wə·šê·ḇeṭ ‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw yiḵ·leh
verses.literal: He who sows injustice will reap disaster . . . and the rod of his fury will be destroyed

verses.original: טֽוֹב־ עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- ‘a·yin hū yə·ḇō·rāḵ kî- nā·ṯan mil·laḥ·mōw lad·dāl
verses.literal: A generous [man] . . . . . . will be blessed for he shares his bread with the poor

verses.original: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ מָד֑וֹן וְיֵצֵ֣א דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃ וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת
verses.transliteration: gā·rêš lêṣ mā·ḏō·wn wə·yê·ṣê dîn wə·qā·lō·wn wə·yiš·bōṯ
verses.literal: Drive out the mocker and conflict will depart even quarreling and insults will cease

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב טְהוֹר לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו מֶֽלֶךְ׃ רֵעֵ֥הוּ
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ ṭə·hōr lêḇ ḥên śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw me·leḵ rê·‘ê·hū
verses.literal: He who loves a pure heart . . . and gracious lips [will have] the king for a friend

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה עֵינֵ֣י נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ê·nê nā·ṣə·rū ḏā·‘aṯ way·sal·lêp̄ diḇ·rê ḇō·ḡêḏ
verses.literal: The LORD’s eyes keep watch over knowledge but He frustrates the words of the faithless

verses.original: עָ֭צֵל אָמַ֣ר אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·ṣêl ’ā·mar ’ă·rî ḇa·ḥūṣ ’ê·rā·ṣê·aḥ bə·ṯō·wḵ rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: The slacker says [There is] a lion outside I will be slain in the streets

verses.original: פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת עֲ֭מֻקָּה שׁוּחָ֣ה זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִפּוֹל שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: pî zā·rō·wṯ ‘ă·muq·qāh šū·ḥāh zə·‘ūm Yah·weh yip·pōl šām
verses.literal: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־ נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ qə·šū·rāh ḇə·leḇ- nā·‘ar šê·ḇeṭ mū·sār yar·ḥî·qen·nāh mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Foolishness [is] bound up in the heart of a child [but] the rod of discipline drives it far from him

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·šêq dāl lə·har·bō·wṯ lōw nō·ṯên lə·‘ā·šîr ’aḵ- lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: Oppressing the poor to enrich oneself or giving gifts to the rich [will] surely lead to poverty

verses.original: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים תָּשִׁ֥ית וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ū·šə·ma‘ diḇ·rê ḥă·ḵā·mîm tā·šîṯ wə·lib·bə·ḵā lə·ḏa‘·tî
verses.literal: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise apply your mind to my knowledge

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־ שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·‘îm kî- ṯiš·mə·rêm bə·ḇiṭ·ne·ḵā yik·kō·nū yaḥ·dāw ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you . . . and they are constantly on your lips

verses.original: מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף־ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: miḇ·ṭa·ḥe·ḵā lih·yō·wṯ Yah·weh hō·w·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā hay·yō·wm ’ap̄- ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: So that your trust may be in the LORD I instruct you today yes you

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שִׁלְשׁוֹם בְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ḵā·ṯaḇ·tî lə·ḵā šil·šōm bə·mō·w·‘ê·ṣōṯ wā·ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge

verses.original: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אֱמֶ֑ת אִמְרֵ֣י לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֱ֝מֶ֗ת אֲמָרִ֥ים לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā qō·šəṭ ’ĕ·meṯ ’im·rê lə·hā·šîḇ ’ĕ·meṯ ’ă·mā·rîm lə·šō·lə·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: to show you true and reliable words that you may soundly answer those who sent you

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּגְזָל־ דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י ה֑וּא דַל־ וְאַל־ תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḡ·zāl- dāl kî hū ḏal- wə·’al- tə·ḏak·kê ‘ā·nî ḇaš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor and do not crush the afflicted at the gate

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־ קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yā·rîḇ rî·ḇām wə·qā·ḇa‘ ’eṯ- qō·ḇə·‘ê·hem nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder - those who rob them . . .

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־ אָ֑ף בַּ֣עַל לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃ וְאֶת־ חֵ֝מוֹת אִ֥ישׁ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ra‘ ’eṯ- ’āp̄ ba·‘al lō ṯā·ḇō·w wə·’eṯ- ḥê·mō·wṯ ’îš
verses.literal: Do not make friends with an angry man and do not associate with a hot-tempered man

verses.original: פֶּן־ תֶּאֱלַ֥ף אָרְחָתוֹ וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ
verses.transliteration: pen- te·’ĕ·lap̄ ʾå̄·rə·ḥå̄·ṯō wə·lā·qaḥ·tā lə·nap̄·še·ḵā mō·w·qêš
verses.literal: or you may learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־ כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ḇə·ṯō·qə·‘ê- ḵāp̄ ba·‘ō·rə·ḇîm maš·šā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not be one who gives pledges . . . who puts up security for debts

verses.original: אִם־ אֵֽין־ לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ יִקַּ֥ח מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ên- lə·ḵā lə·šal·lêm lām·māh miš·kā·ḇə·ḵā yiq·qaḥ mit·taḥ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: If you have nothing with which to pay why should your bed be taken from under you

verses.original: אַל־ תַּ֭סֵּג עוֹלָ֑ם גְּב֣וּל אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃ עָשׂ֣וּ
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·sêḡ ‘ō·w·lām gə·ḇūl ’ă·šer ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed

verses.original: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ׀ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ יִתְיַצָּ֑ב לִֽפְנֵֽי־ מְלָכִ֥ים בַּל־ יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zî·ṯā ’îš mā·hîr bim·laḵ·tōw yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣāḇ lip̄·nê- mə·lā·ḵîm bal- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê ḥă·šuk·kîm
verses.literal: Do you see a man skilled in his work He will be stationed in the presence of kings he will not stand before obscure men
